notes.title: Updated demo version of True Thief
notes.notes:
Friends, by your requests we decided to expand the demo location. In this regard, a number of changes have been added to the demo.


Key changes:
The territory of the location has increased, it became 2 times larger, as well as the number of guards on it.

Added 4 interactive houses with loot and notes revealing the world of True Thief.

Hiding in the dark has been increased to medium difficulty. Guards can see Enveth better when illuminated, keep an eye on the stealth indicator at the top.

Fixed a number of bugs found by players.

Added full Russian and English voice acting.

Added support for wide monitors.



We hope that now the extended demo will allow players to play longer in the atmosphere of the dark Middle Ages and hide from the guards in the bushes.
